answer_1.quote: We apply the LLM-Evolve framework to three prominent benchmarks: (1) MMLU for general language tasks... (2) GSM8K, containing 8.5K ... grade school math word problems... (3) AgentBench, which evaluates LLMs' multi-turn interaction capabilities when solving real-world problems, such as solving real-world problems on an operating system.
answer_1.outputs: multiple-choice answers, numeric answers, and Linux command-line scripts/code

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy in all three benchmarks. The results show consistent predictive performance gains of 1-17% across all benchmarks.
